project.title: QM-GR unification reduced to six-channel candidate admission, not a unified dynamics
project.hidden_assumption: A single scalar formula or causal-set observable block can be promoted into a full QM-GR unification dynamics.

contradiction.proposition_A: QM and GR can be unified by finding a single fundamental equation or one privileged observable formula.
contradiction.proposition_B: Known source, mediator, noise, entropy, observable, and frame boundaries prevent a current single-formula closure.
contradiction.why_not_both: If a candidate is a true unified dynamics it must close all six operational channels; LP7 only constructs an interface/admission layer and explicitly lacks a shared action, Hamiltonian, path integral, stochastic generator, or observable algebra.
contradiction.resolution: LP7 closes at an interface and screening layer: I[T] plus J_unify[I[T]]. It is a candidate-admission functional, not a confirmed unified theory.

derivation_chain.description: Candidate theory is mapped into a six-channel operational interface.

formulas.label: F1

Tuple inequality is componentwise admission, not scalar action minimization

claims.statement: LP7 discovered a confirmed unified QM-GR dynamical equation.
evidence_against: No shared action, Hamiltonian, path integral, stochastic generator, or unified observable algebra was produced
J_unify is admission functional, not fundamental equation

evidence_against: J_obs_CS is only the observable response block

predictions.statement: A concrete candidate theory T that fails any one of the six channels should be classified as partial rather than complete.
predictions.measurement_conditions: Apply I[T] construction to a specific candidate theory, not to an abstract template.

predictions.statement: Causal-set observable matching can pass J_obs while leaving other unification blocks unresolved.
predictions.observable: J_obs_CS and remaining J_PG, J_BMV, J_hybrid, J_BH, J_frame
predictions.measurement_conditions: Test causal-set candidates against the full six-channel interface.

lessons.lesson: A screening functional is useful but must not be presented as a fundamental dynamics.
Inherited literature libraries can invalidate closure confidence when the new LP topic changes scope.
Further progress requires choosing a concrete candidate T and evaluating all six channels, not adding more abstract blocks.
